contract.topology: Clear/API raw replacement/importReplace/Open/startup invalidate history; importAppend/Measure append preserve nonconflicting source rows/defaults. Invalid/no-op/Keep/cancel/denied edits do not alter history or redo.
contract.limits: Current validated history_limit applies independently to image documents and the Results table; processing_memory_mb caps Results retained history. Do not use history_memory_mb pixel budget for table metadata. Cap trim drops farthest redo then oldest applied entries; if remaining one cannot fit after explicit cap reduction, clear history only, preserve current data. Admission failure before a new edit/travel preserves prior data/cursor/branch. No new setting.
contract.undo: Restore prior raw key absence rather than a synthesized default; restore typed integer/double/text/bool/null and even prior compound/nonfinite raw cells exactly. Current view criteria/other fields/settings/imagehistory unchanged. Keep global image Undo and text-widget Undo routes; new buttons/actions only.
